{{Quote|Calling all units. Suspicious activity on Level 1315.|An Underworld Police officer|<ref name="TCWCatchJedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Underworld Police''' were [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] assigned specifically to [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|patrol]] the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Those [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who were assigned to the underworld were notoriously hardened and burly cops, as opposed to the sleek [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] primarily assigned to the upper levels of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Underworld Police officers wore heavy [[Leather/Legends|leather]] and metal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with mechanical [[Eye/Legends|eye]] coverings, which gave them extra protection and anonymity, while denoting an authoritative presence. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], underworld cops took part in the [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|search]] for fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was eventually captured. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Underworld Police officers were used for patrol on the upper levels of Coruscant, not just the lower ones.

==Description==
{{Quote|She's armed and dangerous. Alert all units.|An Underworld Police officer, discussing Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />}}
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] assigned [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] to the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in contrast to the polished [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] who were primarily charged with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] in the upper levels of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Coruscant cops were known to be burly and hardened [[Officer/Legends|officers]], as they worked in the cutthroat environment of the planet's lower levels. They wore heavy [[Leather/Legends|leather]] and metal [[Armor/Legends|armor]], with their heads completely covered, and mechanical [[Eye/Legends|eye]] coverings to protect them from the many dangers they encountered from the [[Scoundrel/Legends|criminal]] elements of the underworld. The armor gave them a presence of anonymity and authority, and had the added effect of giving them a mystic reputation, as to others it was unclear if they were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], or something else.<ref name="CSFunderpolice" /> Coruscant cops were armed with a [[Coruscant Security Droid Blaster|heavy blaster pistol]],<ref name="TCaJEpGu">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/to-catch-a-jedi-episode-guide|text="To Catch a Jedi" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> and they utilized the [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunship]]<ref name="Republicpolicegunship">{{SWE|technology|republic-police-gunship|Republic police gunship}}</ref> and the [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|Coruscant police speeder]] for patrol and pursuit.<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />

==History==
{{Quote|Looks like the Jedi are after one of their own.|An Underworld Police officer, discussing Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />}}
[[File:RealStoriesOfTheCoruscantHighwayPatrol-TCaJ.png|thumb|left|280px|CSF cops in the underworld]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="SWDMDS1">The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul—Death Sentence'' 1]] established the corresponding [[in-universe]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' as [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the Coruscant Security Force received information from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] had [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped]] from a [[Republic military base]] after being accused of [[Death/Legends|murder]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] had been last seen [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|fleeing]] to the lower levels, and so the Underworld Police were put on high alert. While checking IDs on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|Coruscant train]], several cops noticed the wanted Padawan and gave chase. Though they briefly overpowered her, Tano was able to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] them off. She ran the car length and opened a door of the [[Train/Legends|train]] before she dove onto the adjacent platform as the train passed. Three officers standing on the platform continued to give chase, ordering her to stop. When Tano continued to run, the cops [[Lightfight|opened fire]] on her, but she had already entered an [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] by that [[Time/Legends|time]] and escaped the officers' shots.<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />

Shortly thereafter, two police officers on [[Level 1315/Legends|Level 1315]] spotted an explosion at a [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|warehouse]]. They gave an alert to a search group composed of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], all of whom responded and were able to capture Tano at the warehouse.<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />

In the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, the aging Coruscant police droid models began to be phased out on the upper levels;<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/senate-murders-episode-guide|text="Senate Murders" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> however, they continued to see usage to supplement the Underworld Police officers.<ref name="SofaBS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref> Additionally, with the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were used increasingly for security patrols and police operations, at times interfering with the Coruscant Security Force's own operations. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], two Coruscant Security officers responded to a firefight at [[Landing Platform DDF453-17]] between stormtroopers and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The officers requested backup but were told to stand down as the incident was an Imperial matter.<ref name="SW4">[[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CSF_underworld_concept.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Underworld Police concept art from ''Star Wars: 1313'']]
The Coruscant Underworld Police first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, in the episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]," which aired on [[February 24]], [[2013]]. They were specifically conceived by [[George Lucas]] to add to the environment of the underworld.<ref name="TCaJEpGu" /> They also received an entry in the online [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]], which first identified them by name.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|groups|coruscant-underworld-police|Coruscant underworld police}}</ref> Their Coruscant Security Droid Blaster pistols were sourced from  [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]'s [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="EpgTCAJ">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

They appeared briefly in [[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]], published on [[April 10]], 2013 by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="SW4" /> A concept image of the Underworld Police drawn for the cancelled game ''[[Star Wars: 1313]]'' was released in ''[[Star Wars Art: Concept]]'', published on [[October 15]], 2013.<ref name="Concept">''[[Star Wars Art: Concept]]''</ref>
